name: burpee long jump with push up
description: A burpee with a push-up that finishes in a long forward jump. It is a tough full-body conditioning move.
instructions: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode into a long jump forward.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.
